title: Support of a translated varifold
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} be arbitrary, let V be a rectifiable n-varifold in U, let x₀ ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ}, and let W be a rectifiable n-varifold in {y : y + x₀ ∈ U} whose weight μ_W is the pushforward of μ_V under y ↦ y − x₀. Then spt W := {y : y + x₀ ∈ U} ∩ spt μ_W equals {y : y + x₀ ∈ spt V}, where spt V := U ∩ spt μ_V.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (x₀ : Amb n ℓ) (W : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun y => y + x₀) ⁻¹' U)), W.weight = V.weight.map (fun y => y - x₀) → W.support = (fun y => y + x₀) ⁻¹' V.support
